evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports benchmark results for the GLM-4-9B base model on several typical tasks, with scores of 74.7 on MMLU, 77.1 on C-Eval, 34.3 on GPQA, 84.0 on GSM8K, 30.4 on MATH, and 70.1 on HumanEval.

identity.name: GLM-4-9B
identity.summary: An open-source GLM-4 series language model released by Zhipu AI.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only benchmark scores and basic training data description; no details on design, development, or evaluation process for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card states training data only as 'open-source version of the latest-generation GLM-4 pretrained model series' with no collection, curation, or composition details.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not specify intended or disallowed uses, despite being an open-weight base text model that can be adapted to many downstream tasks.
